title: orders-worker pods CrashLoopBackOff — OOMKilled (exit 137)
description: orders-worker pods are being killed by the kernel and cycling through CrashLoopBackOff. Termination reason is OOMKilled with exit code 137: each pod's heap climbs past the container memory limit while processing its batch queue and the container is killed, then restarts and repeats. This is repeated kill-and-restart, not high-but-stable usage.
